quotes.quote: On our internal benchmark of error-inducing prompts, the error rate at low reasoning effort fell from 53.6% with GPT-5.6 Terra to 16.7% with GPT-6.1 Terra, a drop of nearly 37 percentage points.
At maximum effort, the error rate fell by 18 percentage points to 4.3%, nearly matching the rates for GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol.
This year, we’ve invested heavily in reducing hallucinations and factual errors produced by our models.
Starting today, GPT-6.1 Terra is available to all Plus, Pro, Enterprise, and Edu users in ChatGPT Work and Codex.
Today, we’re introducing GPT-6.1 Terra, the latest model in the GPT-6 series.
We evaluate factuality on de-identified ChatGPT conversations that users of our prior models have flagged as containing factual errors.

These examples are intended to capture especially hallucination-prone cases, so their absolute error rates are expected to be much higher than the true error rates in production and should not be interpreted as hallucination rates observed in production.
We recently refreshed the evaluation to make it more challenging, so the results are no longer directly comparable to those reported in previous GPT-6 system cards.
We include two metrics: (1) whether the model makes any error (the response-level hallucination rate), and (2) whether the model reproduces the specific user-flagged error.

We find that GPT-6.1 Terra makes substantially fewer factual errors and is significantly less likely to reproduce user-reported hallucinations than GPT-6 Sol, achieving performance on par with GPT-6.1 Sol.
For previously launched models, the values published at launch reflect the versions evaluated at that time.
The comparison values for previously launched models that are shown here may reflect later versions of those models, and may vary from the values published at launch.
This system card addendum provides updates on the baseline safety metrics and evaluation results for GPT-6.1 Terra.
Today, we’re introducing GPT-6.1 Terra, the latest model in the GPT-6 series.

不过，OpenAI 此后仍在继续修改这一指标。截至本文撰写时，Astra 和 GPT-5.6 Sol 的幻觉率又分别回到了最初的 4.2% 和 12.2%。
对于发布公告中的数据，我们进行了修正，以确保这些数字能够代表我们对模型可用性能的最佳估计，让用户能够进行有意义的比较。
